Anxiety.text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
Anxiety.prayer: Heavenly Father, help me to relinquish my anxieties and fears, presenting them to You with gratitude. Grant me Your peace, beyond my understanding, to guard my heart and mind in Christ Jesus. Amen.

Anxiety.text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day the evil thereof.
Anxiety.prayer: Lord, guide me to focus on today, entrusting tomorrow into Your hands. Help me to navigate todayâs challenges with Your wisdom and strength. Amen.

Anxiety.text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
Anxiety.prayer: Dear God, I cast all my worries upon You, knowing You care deeply for me. Help me to feel the weight lifted and to trust in Your providence. Amen.

Anxiety.text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
Anxiety.prayer: God, I lay my burdens down before You, trusting in Your promise to sustain me. Keep me steady and unshaken in my faith. Amen.

Anxiety.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
Anxiety.prayer: Jesus, thank You for Your peace, unlike any the world offers. Calm my troubled heart and banish my fears as I rest in Your peace. Amen.

Anxiety.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
Anxiety.prayer: Father, I choose to trust in You with all my heart, rejecting my own understanding. Guide my steps and make my path straight, according to Your will. Amen.

Anxiety.text: Fear thou not; for I with thee: be not dismayed; for I thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
Anxiety.prayer: God, thank You for Your promise to be with me, not to let me be dismayed. Strengthen me, help me, uphold me with Your righteous hand. Amen.

Hope.text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
Hope.prayer: God of hope, fill me with all joy and peace as I trust in You, so that I may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Hope.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
Hope.prayer: Lord, thank You for Your plans for me, plans for my welfare and not for harm, to give me a future filled with hope. Guide me in Your purpose. Amen.

Hope.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
Hope.prayer: Father, bolster my faith to be the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen. Increase my confidence in Your promises. Amen.

Hope.text: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope in thee.
Hope.prayer: Lord, my hope is in You. Help me to always look to You for guidance and strength, knowing You hold my future. Amen.

Hope.text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
Hope.prayer: God, thank You that hope does not disappoint because Your love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit. Let me live in that hope. Amen.

Hope.text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; they shall walk, and not faint.
Hope.prayer: Eternal God, renew my strength as I hope in You. Let me soar on wings like eagles; run and not grow weary; walk and not be faint. Amen.

Hope.text: The LORD my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
Hope.prayer: Lord, You are my portion and my hope. Help me to wait patiently for You, trusting in Your faithfulness. Amen.

Healing.text: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
Healing.prayer: Lord, I seek Your healing, both physical and spiritual. Let the prayers of faith restore me, and forgive any sins Iâve committed. Amen.

Healing.text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
Healing.prayer: Healer of the brokenhearted, bind up my wounds and mend my heart. Your healing touch restores and renews. Amen.

Healing.text: But he wounded for our transgressions, bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
Healing.prayer: By Your wounds, Jesus, we are healed. Thank You for bearing our sins and sorrows. Bring healing and peace to my life. Amen.

Healing.text: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou my praise.
Healing.prayer: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed. Save me and I shall be saved, for You are my praise. Bring Your healing into my life. Amen.

Healing.text: Come unto me, all that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Healing.prayer: Jesus, I come to You weary and burdened. Grant me rest and teach me Your humble ways, that my soul may find rest. Amen.

Healing.text: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
Healing.prayer: Lord Jesus, by Your wounds, we are healed. Help me to live righteously, drawing strength and healing from Your sacrifice. Amen.

Healing.text: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
Healing.prayer: Dear God, I pray for good health and prosperity, just as my soul prospers. Guide me in living a life that honors You. Amen.

Encouragement.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
Encouragement.prayer: Through You, Jesus, I can face all circumstances with strength. Help me to rely on Your power in every aspect of my life. Amen.

Encouragement.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
Encouragement.prayer: Even in the darkest valleys, Lord, I fear no evil, for You are with me. Your guidance and support comfort me. Amen.

Encouragement.text: The name of the LORD a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
Encouragement.prayer: Lord, You are my strong tower; I run to You for safety. Keep me secure in Your strength and love. Amen.

Encouragement.text: When thou passest through the waters, I with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
Encouragement.prayer: In all trials, God, I trust You to be with me. Through waters, fires, and rivers, protect and preserve me. Amen.

Encouragement.text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
Encouragement.prayer: Your grace is sufficient, Lord. In my weakness, Your power is perfected. Let me boast in my weaknesses, that Your strength may rest upon me. Amen.

Encouragement.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to purpose.
Encouragement.prayer: God, work all things together for good in my life, as I love You and am called according to Your purpose. Help me to see Your hand in everything. Amen.

Encouragement.text: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.] God our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Encouragement.prayer: God, my refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble, I rely on Your unwavering support. Keep me steadfast. Amen.

Encouragement.text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, unto the end of the world. Amen.
Encouragement.prayer: Jesus, thank You for Your promise to be with me always. Your presence gives me courage and peace. Amen.

Encouragement.text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
Encouragement.prayer: In You, Jesus, I find peace amidst the worldâs troubles. Help me to take heart, knowing You have overcome the world. Amen.
